summary: Second round, over plan r5. Five of six seats succeeded (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Kimi, GLM); Qwen timed out. Gemini approved with no concerns; Claude, Codex, Kimi and GLM asked for revision. All four found the r4 fixes broadly applied. Three concerns reached agreement: LH1-C14's completing run at the response and roster ceilings cannot fit the retained-file ceiling (Claude, Codex, Kimi); section 3 still starts LH1 at 4ad0d216, before the lint re-sync (Claude, Codex, GLM); and LH1-C10 omits time-bound tests at two of the seven ceilings (Kimi, GLM). Marked blocking: the retained-file bound refuses the packaged and default runs under D4's defaults (Claude, singleton), LH1-C14 (Codex), the start commit (Codex), and LH3's attached-row rule contradicting LH3-C4 (Codex, singleton). Every code fact the driving agent re-checked held. Claude and GLM share one CLI codebase; Kimi's response is retained as incomplete (one preamble line, nothing dropped); one of Codex's three concerns is unanchored.

agreed_concerns.title: LH1-C14's completing run at the response and roster ceilings cannot fit the 64 MiB retained-file ceiling
agreed_concerns.summary: Under the plan's own bound (scheduled sections times the response cap), 4,096 sections at 1 MiB bound a payload near 4 GiB, so the criterion is either impossible or met only by a fixture that schedules few sections; it does not say which.

agreed_concerns.title: Section 3's start condition, main at 4ad0d216, is the commit where the whole-repository lint exits 1
agreed_concerns.summary: The goal says LH1 starts from a lint-clean main carrying the committed re-sync; section 3 still pins the start to 4ad0d216, before that re-sync.

agreed_concerns.title: LH1-C10 names time-bound tests for five of D4's seven ceilings
agreed_concerns.summary: R0.8 asks for a time-bound test at each parameter's ceiling; the route-output (16 MiB) and retained-file (64 MiB) ceilings have none.

prioritized_fixes.title: Make the retained-file bound agree with D4's defaults and ceilings
prioritized_fixes.action: Scope the pre-call bound to /2 runs and derive a /2 run's default retained-file cap from its other limits (scheduled sections times the response cap, plus a stated per-attempt overhead), capped at the ceiling; the packaged /1 configurations keep today's path and bytes. State in D4 that the ceilings cannot all be reached together, and restate LH1-C14 as: a run whose bound exceeds the retained cap refuses before any call; a run at the response ceiling whose scheduled sections fit the retained ceiling completes and replays; a run at the roster and response ceilings with every section scheduled refuses.

prioritized_fixes.title: Restate the start condition as the commit that lands the plan with the re-sync
prioritized_fixes.action: Change section 3's start condition to main at the plan-landing merge (parent 4ad0d216, carrying the dev-tools re-sync), and have the LH1 spec record that the whole-repository ruff exits 0 there.

prioritized_fixes.title: State the rejected-assertion exception in the attached-row rule
prioritized_fixes.action: Rewrite LH3 'Attached facts' to say every attached row of an admitted assertion is kept unless it also names an assertion that was not admitted, and point LH3-C1 and LH3-C4 at that one rule.

prioritized_fixes.title: Name the route-output and retained-file ceilings in LH1-C10
prioritized_fixes.action: Add a route at the route-output ceiling and a retained file at the retained-file ceiling to LH1-C10's time-bound demonstrations, or name the shared test that covers each.

prioritized_fixes.title: Keep the frozen two-argument reading._read on the /1 replay path
prioritized_fixes.action: Say in section 5 that /1 replay keeps calling reading._read(folder, name), that the recorded retained cap applies on the /2 path through a reader local to reading.py, and that depth.py's _read and _decode change only as section 3 lists.

prioritized_fixes.title: Name the fact type rules address on the packaged shape
prioritized_fixes.action: State that on the packaged shape a requirement names assertion_statement (one row per assertion), that the default rules name it, and that a rule naming another packaged fact type refuses.

prioritized_fixes.title: Decide max_rows on a packaged-shape call
prioritized_fixes.action: Refuse max_rows without a shape (or record it as not applicable) and add the case to LH4-C7.
